theorems.name: Submission.idtp_pc_boundary_weak_derivative
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), 1 ≤ n → Orthonormal ℝ τ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = ∫ x in V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), g x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x τ ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ V → ∀ j : Fin n, ∫ x in V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), g x * fderiv ℝ f x (τ j) ∂μHE[n] = 0
